messages:
incident-bot: Alert triggered — GPU memory pressure on pool 'infer-west2a-12'. Metrics: vmem 85%, kvcache_evictions spike, ~30 CUDA alloc failures/min. PagerDuty P123456 fired. link: https://pd.redwood/P123456
pagerduty-bot: P123456 routed to escalation policy 'gpu-infra' and notified rotation.
oncall-alex: Acked P123456 :hand: I'm taking this. Quick triage — pulling kernel & nvml logs now.
oncall-alex: running quick check: `journalctl -u node-agent | rg "cudaMalloc" | tail -n 10` — seeing repeated "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" on gpunode-12
oncall-priya: noted. Traffic for model-qa-2 is spiking from BetaCorp, looks correlated. Will prepare fallback routing.
infra-ryan: kernel shows high slab/alloc churn, nvml reports persistent allocations not releasing. Possibly prefetch & kvcache pressure.
oncall-alex: executing policy: auto-fallthrough -> shift 40% traffic off infer-west2a-12 to fallback-pool-west, enable quantized model variant for heavy endpoints.
incident-bot: Auto-reroute executed (policy: low-latency-fallback). Traffic moved ~40% -> fallback-pool-west. Estimated latency delta +60ms for affected requests.
customer-success-lia: BetaCorp reports increased tail latency and some timeouts since 14:02 UTC. Customer-facing ticket created ID RBW-8921.
oncall-priya: Lia — can you confirm impacted model IDs? I'll start draining the node if confirmed.
customer-success-lia: Affected: summit-prod-v1 and model-qa-2. Ticket note added.
oncall-alex: Starting controlled drain of gpunode-12: `kubectl cordon gpunode-12 && kubectl drain gpunode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — will evict pods to fallback pool.
oncall-priya: Evacuation in progress, pods rescheduling. Monitoring for reschedule failures/backpressure :eyes:
infra-ryan: Temporary config change: reduce kv cache prefetch from 128 -> 64 on infer-west2a pools to reduce sustained allocs. Watching metrics.
oncall-alex: After cordon/drain, observed OOMs drop to ~2/min (from ~30/min). Auto-reroute kept user impact limited. Keeping pager open until 1h stable.
pagerduty-bot: P123456 acknowledged by oncall-alex. Severity marked Sev2.
oncall-alex: assigning RCA to infra-ryan and oncall-priya. Investigation notes: look at prefetch heuristics, per-worker mem accounting, and potential kernel nvlink/driver regression.
customer-success-lia: Updated BetaCorp: partial service restored, engineering investigating cause. Lia to follow up with patch ETA. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Activity log saved to incident channel. Will escalate if OOMs rise above 5/min or if reschedule fails.
oncall-priya: tagging for postmortem and alert tuning. Will add a follow-up doc with tunables that mitigated this.
oncall-alex: closing triage for now, keeping watch. Reopen if anything flares.
